title: Root correction for a binomial with dominant linear derivative
statement: Let $F$ be a field [def-weil-field] equipped with a real absolute value satisfying $|x|=0$ exactly for $x=0$, $|1|=1$, $|xy|=|x||y|$ and $|x+y|\le\max(|x|,|y|)$. Suppose $F$ is complete for the metric $d(x,y)=|x-y|$. Let $p$ be a prime integer with $|p\cdot1_F|<1$, and let $a,b,c\in F$ satisfy $c\ne0$, $|c|^{p-1}\le|a|$ and $|c^p-ac+b|<|ac|$. Then there exists $z\in F$ with $z^p-az+b=0$ and $|z-c|<|c|$. In particular $|z|=|c|$.
